records.text: I entered Crossroads in Antigua for rehab.
records.speaker: Hunter Biden

appearances.snippet: He put me on a plane in New York and I flew to a place that was started by Eric Clapton called Crossroads in Antigua and I went to rehab and I came out and I went directly when I came out, my brother picked me up from the airport.

verification.notes: Multiple biographical accounts, including reporting based on Hunter Biden's memoir, place him at Crossroads Centre in Antigua for addiction treatment. This matches the transcript context.

sources.title: In new memoir, Hunter Biden seeks to reframe political scandals but omits key details
sources.relevance: Independent review of his memoir and addiction-treatment history supports attendance at Crossroads in Antigua.
